alternatives.title: Meeting Rooms
alternatives.review_notes: Determine whether all intervals can be attended; an end equal to a start does not overlap. GFG interval array interface matches the task.

alternatives.title: Meeting Rooms II
alternatives.review_notes: Minimum concurrent rooms; touching endpoints reuse a room. GFG accepts parallel start/end arrays instead of pairs.

alternatives.title: Longest Subarray with Sum K
alternatives.review_notes: Return maximum contiguous subarray length for exact target sum. Both support negative numbers; no match returns zero.

alternatives.title: Largest BST
alternatives.review_notes: Return node count of the largest BST subtree; strict left/right comparisons and no duplicate values.

alternatives.title: Add 1 to a Linked List Number
alternatives.review_notes: Forward-order decimal digits in a linked list; add one, carry through nines, return the updated head.

alternatives.title: Tree Boundary Traversal
alternatives.review_notes: Anticlockwise root, left boundary excluding leaves, all leaves, reversed right boundary; no duplicate root/leaves.

alternatives.title: Number of Distinct Islands
alternatives.review_notes: Four-direction islands, shapes equivalent by translation only; rotations/reflections remain distinct. GFG uses L/W cells instead of 1/0.

alternatives.title: Min Cost to Connect Ropes
alternatives.review_notes: Each merge costs the sum of two lengths; minimise total accumulated merge cost. Ropes and sticks differ only in naming.

alternatives.title: Common in 3 Sorted Arrays
alternatives.review_notes: Return sorted common values across three sorted arrays. GFG additionally accepts duplicates and returns each common value once.

alternatives.title: Median in a Row-Wise Sorted Matrix
alternatives.review_notes: Odd-sized row-sorted matrix; return median across every entry. Same value-space binary search/counting task.
